events.summary: Baseline review of Forgotten Favourites 0.1.0: exact package bytes, library.suggest descriptor, no requested permissions, deterministic spacing/taste fixture behavior and privacy boundary were checked.
limitations: Rediscovery only becomes meaningful after Melodex has accumulated local play/feedback signals.
The spacing curve is a transparent heuristic and is not a psychological or clinical model of preference.
Melodex sends relative recency rather than absolute timestamps, but extension subprocesses are not yet protected by a complete OS sandbox.
